clips.title: The story
paras: Ironband’s report is bound for Ironforge from Thelsamar in Loch Modan. It carries news from the excavation site to Prospector Stormpike in the Assembly of Explorers, where the stalled dig and missing blastpowder need attention.

The Explorers' League funds, supplies, and oversees archaeological expeditions across Khaz Modan. Prospector Ironband's dig in southern Loch Modan has run short of blasting supplies, and its overseers cannot simply requisition more nearby. At the Thelsamar inn, Jern Hornhelm entrusts you with Ironband's written report. You carry it over the mountain passes to Prospector Stormpike at the League's headquarters in Ironforge.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: We'll need approval to get Ironband more blastpowder. You'll have to take his report to the Explorers' League headquarters in Ironforge.
Here's the report. Give it to Prospector Stormpike, and don't forget to duck after you deliver it. Stormpike is hotheaded, and he won't be happy to hear of Ironband's slow progress at the site.
You'll find Stormpike in the Assembly of Explorers.

clips.title: Progress
paras: We Stormpikes don't like being bothered with trivial matters, adventurer. I hope you brought news worthy of my valuable attention.

clips.title: Completion
paras: Curse that Ironband! I sent him a load of blastpowder weeks ago, but he's made no mention of it in this report.
